tickets.title: Open new client account
tickets.text: Open the approved joint taxable account for Lila Copperwisp and Rowan Thistlefable at Velvet Acorn Custody, the existing custodian. Confirm registration, joint ownership details, funding from the roughly $58,000 at Teacup Comet Bank, online access and electronic statements for both spouses, and document delivery preferences before submitting the application package.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to open a joint taxable account at the existing custodian, initially funded from Teacup Comet Bank savings, with online access and electronic statements for both spouses, due 2024-10-18.

tickets.title: Prepare retirement beneficiary forms
tickets.text: Prepare retirement beneficiary forms for Lila Copperwisp naming Rowan Thistlefable as primary and Camila Copperwisp as contingent where allowed, covering the $410,000 IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody and the $126,000 401(k).
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare retirement beneficiary forms naming Rowan primary and Camila Copperwisp contingent where allowed, due 2024-10-25.

tickets.title: Collect certified marriage certificate
tickets.text: Collect the certified marriage certificate for Lila Copperwisp and Rowan Thistlefable because custodian and bank records at Velvet Acorn Custody and Teacup Comet Bank still show Lila's prior household status.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to collect the certified marriage certificate because custodian and bank records still show Lila’s prior household status, due 2024-10-14.
